onboarding.session.waiting: The operation owner has not confirmed completion. Reopen with /setup.
onboarding.session.unavailable: First-run setup screens could not be shown ({code}); the workline opens without them.
onboarding.session.unavailableField: First-run setup screens could not be shown ({code}: the {family} facts refuse the field {field}); the workline opens without them.
onboarding.work.available: Sign-in found; native preflight checks usability
onboarding.work.unavailable: Install the CLI and sign in, or choose Later
onboarding.provider.approval: Connection is waiting for approval. Inspect approvals, then reopen /setup.
onboarding.budget.question: Set a spending limit for metered API calls
onboarding.budget.confirm: Set the scope spending limit to {usd} USD? Normal policy and approval checks apply.
onboarding.permissions.title: Permission settings
onboarding.permissions.unavailable: Profile defaults cannot be observed in this build. Permissions remain unchanged. Use /mode or /policy, or return with /setup.
onboarding.firstTask.title: Ready! Choose your first task
onboarding.firstTask.body: This finishes onboarding. Deferred setup and all policy, budget and approval checks still apply.
onboarding.firstTask.later: Open the workline without a task
onboarding.firstTask.project.label: Explore and summarize this project
onboarding.firstTask.project.intent: Inspect this project and summarize its purpose and structure. Do not change files.
onboarding.firstTask.readme.label: Update the README
onboarding.firstTask.readme.intent: Inspect the project and propose a README update, then perform any approved documentation changes through normal policy.
onboarding.firstTask.newProject.label: Start a new project here
onboarding.firstTask.newProject.intent: This folder is empty. Ask me what I want to build, propose a simple structure, and create the first files only after I agree, through normal policy.
onboarding.firstTask.buildRun.label: Explain how to install and run it
onboarding.firstTask.buildRun.intent: Read this project's build and package files and explain step by step how to install and run it. Do not change files.
onboarding.firstTask.readmeWrite.label: Write a README
onboarding.firstTask.readmeWrite.intent: This project has no README. Inspect it and write one that says what it is, how to install it and how to use it; apply it through normal policy.
onboarding.firstTask.plan.label: Plan the first steps together
onboarding.firstTask.plan.intent: Help me plan the work I want to do in this folder: first ask me a few questions, then propose a step-by-step plan. Do not change files.
onboarding.firstTask.improve.label: Suggest improvements
onboarding.firstTask.improve.intent: Inspect this project and suggest the three most useful improvements, with the reason for each. Do not change files.
onboarding.firstTask.draft.label: Draft a first document together
onboarding.firstTask.draft.intent: Help me draft a first document in this folder: ask what it should be about, then write a draft through normal policy.
onboarding.firstTask.tests.label: Run the tests and explain the result
onboarding.firstTask.tests.intent: Inspect the available test instructions and run applicable checks through normal policy. Explain the results and any limits.
onboarding.firstTask.summary.label: Summarize this folder
onboarding.firstTask.summary.intent: Inspect accessible files in this folder and summarize what is present. If empty or unavailable, explain that. Do not modify anything.
onboarding.firstTask.topics.label: List the main topics
onboarding.firstTask.topics.intent: Read the accessible documents in this folder and list their main topics and unknowns. Do not change files or external systems.
onboarding.firstTask.questions.label: Suggest useful questions
onboarding.firstTask.questions.intent: Inspect this folder and suggest useful questions to clarify the intended work. Do not modify files or external systems.
onboarding.parked.released: Ready to request a start; no work has started.
onboarding.parked.cancelled: This intent was cancelled. A new task needs a new command identity.
error.WORKER_SETUP_PENDING: Worker setup is waiting ({phase}). Reopen /setup; no new planning is started by this response.
error.WORKER_IMAGE_DECLINED: Worker image acquisition was declined. Reopen /setup to choose the next action.
onboarding.imageConsent.title: Prepare a worker image for {provider}?
onboarding.imageConsent.body: Download sources below; estimated disk {size} GB, build limit {timeout}. Existing measured build times are unavailable.
onboarding.imageConsent.limits: Consent allows background acquisition only. Registry, worker settings and pool changes need the later ready confirmation; this starts no task.
onboarding.parked.status.starting: start requested; reconcile the same command
onboarding.ready.body: Confirm worker settings, then the selected image profile and the execution pool. Each owner keeps its policy and revision checks.
onboarding.ready.title: Confirm worker readiness
onboarding.parked.title: Waiting task
onboarding.parked.unknown: A start request is recorded. Reconcile its existing result before any retry.
onboarding.permissions.guided: Profile {profile} starts in {mode}: routine work may proceed under company policy. Protected settings, secrets and destructive actions keep their approval rules. Change the mode with Shift+Tab or /mode; inspect grants in /policy. Continue opens this profile default for {principal} in scope {scope}.
onboarding.profile.title: Add the selected coding provider
onboarding.profile.body: Provider {provider}, image {image}, profile {profile}, task kind {kind}. Existing profiles and kinds are preserved. Apply this exact registry preview?
setup.coding.firstCommit.title: First Git commit
setup.coding.firstCommit.offer: This repository has no commits. You can create the first one now or return later.
setup.coding.firstCommit.done: The repository already has a commit.
setup.coding.firstCommit.recovery: HEAD was committed; the index needs reconciliation. After other Git writers finish, use the retained path list below. This changes only the named index entries, leaving HEAD and worktree unchanged. Review before running.
setup.coding.firstCommit.overlap: Concurrent staging overlaps committed paths. Reconcile these paths manually; no reset command is offered.
setup.coding.firstCommit.locked: Another Git writer holds index.lock. Wait for it to finish; never delete its lock.
setup.coding.firstCommit.staged: Staged changes already exist. Commit them yourself with git commit; onboarding will observe the result on relaunch.
setup.coding.firstCommit.empty: This repository has no files to commit yet. Add your files, then come back to the first commit with /setup.
setup.coding.firstCommit.summary: Selected {count}/{total} files; {more} additional rows are not shown. Flagged files are excluded unless explicitly selected.
setup.coding.firstCommit.sign: Your Git signing setting is enabled; signing may ask on your terminal. Failure does not create a commit.
setup.coding.firstCommit.noSign: Your Git configuration does not request commit signing.
setup.coding.firstCommit.noHooks: Git hooks do not run for this first commit.
setup.coding.firstCommit.identity: Git identity is missing. Set user.name and user.email with git config, then reopen /setup.
setup.coding.firstCommit.recoveryUnavail: First-commit recovery evidence cannot be read safely. Inspect the repository manually; no commit or reset is applied.
onboarding.permissions.chooseProfile: Choose a profile to preview its starting permissions. Nothing is written until the next confirmation.
onboarding.permissions.profileMissing: Profile {profile} will be saved and start in {mode} for {principal} in scope {scope}. Protected settings, secrets and destructive actions keep their approval rules. Confirm to complete the pending installation permissions.
onboarding.permissions.preserved: Your existing mode choice ({mode}) is preserved for {principal} in scope {scope}.
onboarding.permissions.profileWithoutDef: Profile {profile} has no permission defaults. Confirm saves this profile and preserves the existing mode ({mode}) for {principal} in scope {scope}.
